verdict.rationale: Weave's SDK supports creating Dataset objects and Evaluation objects with scoring functions programmatically (docs-6, docs-25, docs-31), and the docs describe an MCP server plus 'W&B skills' letting coding agents like Claude Code 'read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own' (docs-20, docs-44, docs-45), plus a REST Service API for programmatic result retrieval (docs-15). However, there is no concrete end-to-end example showing an agent autonomously creating a dataset object and then reading back structured eval results via the MCP/API path. Missing for 10: explicit documented workflow/example of agent-initiated dataset creation, explicit MCP tool for triggering an Evaluation run, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full loop working.
